g.text: Everything happens in the first ten minutes: the line fills and each node

text.style: font-size: 7.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #898781

g.text: reaches the inflow temperature. For the remaining five hours the water stays at

text.style: font-size: 7.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #898781

g.text: 18.00 °C while the air rises to 22 °C — a 35-minute residence in 500 m of

text.style: font-size: 7.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #898781

g.text: pipe is far too short for the surface to move it. Heat here is transport, not exchange.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start
